mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1250 thousand units signals robust residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive equity valuations through improved corporate earnings expectations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST exceeds 1250 thousand units (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it triggers market anticipation of aggressive Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as discount rates rise and liquidity contracts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates accelerating labor market tightness that fuels wage inflation, prompting Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase does not produce negative returns (SPX 20-day returns > 0) in >50% of instances meeting both conditions over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), restrictive monetary policy reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as economic growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates strong manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals an overheating labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of CPIAUCSL rise and FEDFUNDS increase does not produce negative returns (SPX 5-day returns > 0) in >50% of instances meeting both conditions over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high housing market regimes (HOUST > 1300 thousand units), strong residential construction drives consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as economic growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST exceeds 1300 thousand units (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
